text:
maria: Hey @cheng @alex — I'm blocked merging #4123. Docs preview says `response_mode` defaults to `stream` in the SDK snippet but runtime folks say it might be `buffered`. Can you confirm what the hosted API actually uses by default?

cheng: I flagged this in the PR review, thanks. The snippet is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123/files#diff-abc123

alex: I can check. Which exact call are we documenting? The chat `create` endpoint or the legacy `generate` call?

maria: It's the chat example under "Tooling + streaming" — shows function-calling + streaming. The snippet looks like:```js
await client.chat.create({
  model: 'rwi-chat-1',
  messages,
  response_mode: 'stream', // doc snippet
});
```

sam: Docs CI preview is failing too: `docs-builder` linkcheck passed but the preview deploy failed with `docs-preview: invalid JSON in generated api-surface` — guessing because runtime default differs from sample output expectations.

alex: Quick answer: runtime default is `buffered` for hosted chat unless `stream=true` is explicitly set at the API layer. SDK helper previously mapped `response_mode` -> streaming, but that mapping was removed in a runtime patch last quarter.

cheng: Oof. So docs claiming default `stream` is wrong. Is this intended behavior or a regression? @alex any link to the runtime change?

alex: It was an intentional change to stabilize metrics: we made streaming opt-in so fallback & cache semantics are deterministic. Patch note: infra/notes:2025-11-stream-toggle. I'll paste the release blurb in a sec.

olivia: For the docs side, we should either update the snippet and call out `stream: true` explicitly, or document that `response_mode` isn't auto-enabled by SDK. Reviewers are blocking until we pick one.

maria: If runtime is `buffered` by default, updating the snippet to be explicit seems safest. Can someone confirm the SDK surface mapping? I don't want to change code examples that are misleading.

alex: Confirmed: current JS SDK no longer coerces `response_mode` to stream. You need to do:```js
await client.chat.create({
  model: 'rwi-chat-1',
  messages,
  response_mode: 'stream',
  stream: true, // required at HTTP layer
});
```

cheng: Great, thanks. @maria, quick edit suggestion: update snippet + add a one-line note: "Streaming is opt-in; set `stream: true` on the request to enable streaming at the API layer." That should satisfy reviewers and fix the preview generation mismatch.

maria: I'll push a tiny docs change now. One more thing — do we want to mention behavior for Private/Dedicated where the default might differ? There was talk that Dedicated had streaming enabled by default in some infra configs.

alex: Good call. Dedicated customers can configure a routing policy that enables streaming by default, but the platform default documented in the public API is `buffered`. Add a short footnote: "Dedicated deployments may have different defaults per contract."

sam: @maria FYI the preview should republish once you push; `docs-ci-bot` will re-run linkcheck + api-surface generation.

docs-ci-bot: Re-run queued for https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — CI will update within ~2m :gear:

maria: Done — pushed change and updated snippet + footnote. Thanks all. @cheng can you re-review the PR when CI finishes?

cheng: Will do. If CI looks green I'll approve. Thanks for the quick runtime clarify @alex.

alex: No problem. Filed an internal note to sync the SDK docs generator with runtime defaults so this doesn't sneak back in.

maria: Closing loop — merge unblocked if CI passes. :rocket:
